result.summary: The environment is a wide urban arterial with multiple travel lanes and a signalized intersection. While sidewalks are in good condition and pedestrian signals are present, the significant crossing distance and lack of mid-block refuges increase pedestrian exposure to high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross at least four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes and a lack of traffic calming measures encourage higher vehicle speeds in an urban context.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median at the intersection to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the standard transverse markings to high-visibility continental or ladder patterns to increase driver awareness.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, well-maintained sidewalk with decorative paving adjacent to a historic building, providing a comfortable walking environment. However, the intersection lacks essential safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps, creating accessibility barriers and reducing pedestrian visibility.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The absence of painted crosswalks at the intersection corner fails to designate a safe path for pedestrians and reduces driver awareness.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The vertical curb at the corner lacks a sloped transition, creating a significant barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.

hazards.name: Large Drain Grate
hazards.description: A large metal grate is positioned near the curb, which could catch small wheels or be a tripping hazard.

interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver yielding rates.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install directional curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to ensure the intersection is accessible to all users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
